text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of lungs. Flattened diaphragm. No focal lung opacities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflation and a flattened diaphragm are classic signs of air trapping, which we see in conditions like emphysema or chronic bronchitis. Do you have a significant history of smoking or exposure to dust/chemicals?
